race.comment: BUDERIM (2) led last time out at Pinjarra and was too good, inching away to score by 1.3L. He steps out in trip for the first time, but he's improved a bunch this campaign and there's nothing to say the extra trip is a query. Can work across and dictate from the front. BACK TO BONDI (1) is on the quick turnaround after an impressive win here last time out, scoring as the race favourite on the quick turnaround. Can track BUDERIM across from the barrier and there may be more to come from him just yet. STREAK OF GOD (6) is better than he showed last time out when disappointing as the race favourite. He's better than that however and the winkers replace the blinkers. Pike sticks and he can improve. THE NUN (3) can improve on the fresh effort getting right out to this trip second-up. IMPRESSIVE JEWEL (4) should get every chance from the inside barrier.
